summary: Frontend testing of sidebar conversation history feature (ChatGPT-style). All 8 requested features verified working. Logged in as super admin (jcuradeau.7@gmail.com), sidebar renders conversation history grouped by TODAY/YESTERDAY between New Chat button and nav items. 16 conversations fetched from /api/atlas/conversations. Clicking a conv highlights it and loads messages in Atlas chat. New Chat clears and shows Atlas welcome with 4 suggestion cards. Collapsed desktop sidebar (56px) hides conversations and shows Atlas planet icon. Mobile overlay sidebar shows full titles for all 16 conversations. Theme toggle (Dark<->Light) and VIP hub button work.

issues: 16 conversations shown without pagination or a max-height with independent scroll for the conv list; on smaller heights the nav items get pushed below the fold and require scrolling. Consider capping the conv list height or grouping into a collapsible section like ChatGPT.

Duplicate conversation titles are shown (e.g. 'Say hi in one word' x2, 'test' x2, 'Bonjour Atlas, un mot rapide sur BT...' x2, 'Salut Atlas!' x3). Not a code bug - reflects data - but visually confusing. Consider showing a small time-of-day hint next to duplicate titles.

action_items: (Optional/design) Add max-height + inner scroll to conversation list so nav items remain visible without scrolling the whole sidebar.
(Optional) Consider deduping or timestamping conversation titles that share the same title in the same group.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx line 60-62 & 68-70: fetch calls lack proper error handling / status check. If /api/atlas/conversations returns non-200 (e.g., 401), r.json() may still parse an error object and setConversations([]) never runs; d.conversations||[] handles the shape but not auth errors. Consider handling r.ok explicitly.
_layout.tsx setInterval 30s poll for conversations runs regardless of tab visibility - minor perf/network cost. Consider pausing when document is hidden.

atlasNavStore.ts: selectedConversationId is not reset when the user manually navigates in-app to a different conversation from ChatView's own list (if any) - could cause stale highlight; low priority.
seed_data_creation: None - used the 16 existing conversations already in DB
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar conv history feature is fully functional. testIDs used: sidebar-panel, sidebar-new-chat-button, sidebar-conv-{uuid}, sidebar-nav-{index|market|news|profile|learn}, sidebar-close, sidebar-toggle (mobile hamburger), theme-toggle, sidebar-vip-button, login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-btn. Group labels rendered in UPPERCASE via CSS textTransform: 'uppercase' (source text is 'Today', 'Yesterday', etc).
